commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo RUN
date -u
CERTS_READY=0
if [ -n "${RAGIN_MTLS_CERT_FILE:-}" ] && [ -n "${RAGIN_MTLS_KEY_FILE:-}" ] && [ -n "${RAGIN_MTLS_CA_FILE:-}" ]; then
  if [ -f "${RAGIN_MTLS_CERT_FILE:-}" ] && [ -f "${RAGIN_MTLS_KEY_FILE:-}" ] && [ -f "${RAGIN_MTLS_CA_FILE:-}" ]; then
    CERTS_READY=1
  fi
fi
echo CERTS_READY=$CERTS_READY
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
echo TMPDIR=$TMPDIR
echo OPENSSL_PRESENT=$(command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo yes || echo no)
if [ "$CERTS_READY" = "1" ] && [ "$(command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo yes || echo no)" = "yes" ]; then
  echo CASE_1_MISSING_CERT_BEGIN
  if openssl s_client -connect 172.31.17.217:8443 \
    -CAfile "${RAGIN_MTLS_CA_FILE}" \
    -verify_return_error \
    -brief -no_ign_eof < /dev/null > "${TMPDIR}/case1_missing_cert.txt" 2>&1; then
    echo CASE1_EXIT=0
  else
    echo CASE1_EXIT=$?
  fi
  echo CASE1_HEAD_BEGIN
  head -n 80 "${TMPDIR}/case1_missing_cert.txt"
  echo CASE1_HEAD_END
  echo CASE_2_BAD_CA_CHAIN_BEGIN
  if openssl s_client -connect 172.31.17.217:8443 \
    -CAfile "${TMPDIR}/nonexistent_ca.crt" \
    -verify_return_error \
    -brief -no_ign_eof < /dev/null > "${TMPDIR}/case2_bad_ca.txt" 2>&1; then
    echo CASE2_EXIT=0
  else
    echo CASE2_EXIT=$?
  fi
  echo CASE2_HEAD_BEGIN
  head -n 80 "${TMPDIR}/case2_bad_ca.txt"
  echo CASE2_HEAD_END
else
  echo CASES_SKIPPED=yes
fi
rm -rf "${TMPDIR}"
echo DONE
